correctness.rationale: For iid deterministic spatial arrows and geometric whole-field refresh blocks, the first opposite arrow K is geometric and a frozen walk enters an alternating 2-cycle. Direct sums give first and second generating functions R_t(z)=(1+tz)/[(1-tz)(1-z²)] and S_t(z)=(1+tz)²/[(1-tz)²(1-z²)]. The independent reward blocks (L,D) have geometric L; the renewal-reward law and CLT give v=p²H_a(1-p) and Sigma=p²J-2p²v(H+zH′)+(2-p)v²/p. Algebra yields the displayed speed and its derivative. For a=1/2, Sigma=p(3-p)²/[(2-p)(1+p)²], derivative positive on 0<p<1; for a≠1/2, Sigma(1)=4a(1-a), derivative 0, second derivative 24a(1-a)(2a-1)²>0, while Sigma(p)→0 at p↓0. Continuity forces a strictly higher interior maximizer and rules out global strict increase for any asymmetric bias. Independent SymPy verified rational identities. No uniqueness of maximizer asserted.
